entries.title: Choose which approved fix goes first
entries.what: WI-1 and WI-2 are authorized within INI-1. As work priority owner, the operator has reserved this customer priority choice; either order fits the current capacity.
entries.lean_why: The example customer needs the export before using search.
entries.waits: The two fixes wait for their order; no extra capacity is requested.

entries.title: Accept a narrower pilot outcome
entries.what: INI-1 could validate one workflow instead of two within the existing PF-1 envelope. The operator, acting as sponsor, owns changes to the accepted pilot outcome.
options: Validate one workflow with stronger evidence
entries.lean_why: The narrower scope tests the highest-uncertainty outcome without new investment.
entries.waits: The proposed scope change waits; already authorized work remains authorized.

entries.title: Select whether to invest in the next discovery effort
entries.what: PF-2 is an unselected opportunity discovered while doing WI-3. The operator, acting as portfolio owner, must decide whether to allocate existing capacity to bounded discovery at the expense of another candidate.
options: Select PF-2 and allocate the proposed discovery capacity
Defer PF-2 and retain the present allocation
entries.lean: Defer until the tradeoff evidence is ready
entries.lean_why: The candidate has no accepted capacity envelope or comparative benefit evidence yet.
entries.waits: PF-2 discovery cannot start without a recorded selection and capacity decision.
